title: VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents
title_zh: VeriCUA：将验证作为计算机使用智能体的智能体式探索

paragraphs.en: Building and scaling computer-using agents (CUAs) across desktop, mobile, and web environments requires reliable task-completion verification for data curation, evaluation, and reinforcement learning. Typical automated approaches prompt vision-language models (VLMs) to judge trajectories or generate programs to inspect application state. However, both rely on partial views of complex digital environments. VLM judges are restricted to supplied observations, while generated programs depend on accessible state. These views can omit decisive evidence or leave completion judgments unsupported. Tailoring separate verifiers to different platforms and access settings adds further engineering cost. We present VeriCUA, a platform-agnostic framework for verification through agentic exploration. It treats verification as dynamic evidence gathering and assessment within a shared procedure for online and offline settings across platforms and observation modalities. After inspecting the available context to construct a task rubric, the verifier selects GUI or code checks for unresolved requirements and combines their findings under explicit evidence rules. Experiments show improved agreement with reference labels over the compared baselines across these settings, with the largest offline gains on hard cases and stronger rejection of false completion claims online. Further analyses connect these gains to complementary evidence and test-time exploration.
paragraphs.zh: 在桌面、移动和网页环境中构建并扩展使用计算机的智能体（CUA），需要可靠的任务完成验证来支持数据整理、评估和强化学习。 常见的自动化方法会提示视觉语言模型（VLM）对轨迹进行判断，或生成程序来检查应用状态。 然而，这两种方式都依赖于对复杂数字环境的部分视图。 VLM 判断者仅限于所提供的观测，而生成的程序则依赖于可访问的状态。 这些视图可能遗漏决定性证据，或使完成判断缺乏依据。 针对不同平台和访问设置定制各自独立的验证器会带来额外的工程成本。 我们提出 VeriCUA，一个与平台无关、通过智能体式探索进行验证的框架。 它将验证视为在统一流程内动态地收集和评估证据，该流程适用于跨平台和跨观测模态的在线与离线设置。 在检查可用上下文以构建任务评分细则后，验证器会针对未解决的要求选择 GUI 检查或代码检查，并在明确的证据规则下综合它们的发现。 实验表明，在上述各种设置中，与所比较的基线相比，本方法与参考标签的一致性更高，其中在困难案例上的离线增益最大，且在线时对错误完成声明的拒绝能力更强。 进一步的分析将这些增益与互补证据以及测试时探索联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) have enabled computer-using agents (CUAs) to navigate the digital world through software interfaces ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Rawles et al., 2025 ) . Given a natural-language instruction, an agent observes the interface, plans, and acts, leaving a trajectory of thoughts, actions, and observations. Digital tasks span applications in which success can depend on visual presentation, application records, or changes to persisted files. A trajectory can appear successful even when edits remain unsaved or an operation fails without a visible warning. The agent may also report completion after fulfilling only part of the instruction. Accepting such a run as successful produces a false positive, making the distinction between attempted actions and their actual effects central to verification. Developing these agents therefore requires reliable judgments throughout evaluation, data curation ( Sun et al., 2025 ) , and reinforcement learning ( Xue et al., 2026a ) , including applications for which no task-specific checker has been supplied.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉语言模型（VLM）使计算机使用智能体（CUA）能够通过软件界面操作数字世界（Xie et al., 2024；Zhou et al., 2024；Rawles et al., 2025）。 给定一条自然语言指令，智能体观察界面、进行规划并执行操作，留下由思考、动作和观察组成的轨迹。 数字任务涵盖各类应用，其成败可能取决于视觉呈现、应用记录或对持久化文件的更改。 即使编辑尚未保存或某项操作在没有可见警告的情况下失败，轨迹仍可能显得成功。 智能体也可能在仅完成指令的一部分后就报告任务完成。 将这样的运行判定为成功会产生假阳性，因此区分尝试过的动作与其实际效果成为验证的核心。 因此，开发这类智能体需要在评估、数据整理（Sun et al., 2025）和强化学习（Xue et al., 2026a）的整个过程中进行可靠的判断，包括那些没有提供任务专用检查器的应用。

paragraphs.en: An execution can be verified online from the resulting machine state or offline from its retained trajectory. Evidence can come from rendered interfaces, structured observations, or artifacts such as files and database records. VLM judges assess trajectories from selected observations ( Pan et al., 2024 ) , while automatically generated checkers inspect application state through model-written programs ( Xue et al., 2026b ) . A fixed set of frames may omit a decisive effect, and a generated query may target state that does not answer the verification question. Platform-native signals support more specialized judgments and validation ( Chae et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2026b ) , but their availability varies with the application and access setting. Agentic approaches actively inspect trajectories or environments ( Wan et al., 2026 ; Cui et al., 2026 ; Sanayei et al., 2026 ) . A shared procedure must seek relevant evidence under these access constraints and ground its conclusions in the observations.
paragraphs.zh: 一次执行既可以通过最终机器状态在线验证，也可以通过其保留的轨迹离线验证。 证据可以来自渲染的界面、结构化的观测，或诸如文件和数据库记录之类的产物。 VLM 评判器基于所选观测来评估轨迹（Pan et al., 2024），而自动生成的检查器则通过模型编写的程序来检查应用状态（Xue et al., 2026b）。 固定的帧集合可能遗漏决定性的效果，而生成的查询也可能指向无法回答验证问题的状态。 平台原生信号支持更专门的判断与验证（Chae et al., 2025；Sun et al., 2026b），但其可用性随应用和访问环境而异。 智能体化方法会主动检查轨迹或环境（Wan et al., 2026；Cui et al., 2026；Sanayei et al., 2026）。 共享的流程必须在这些访问约束下寻找相关证据，并将其结论建立在观测之上。

paragraphs.en: To address these evidence and access limitations, we present VeriCUA, a platform-agnostic framework that formulates CUA verification as agentic exploration (Figure 1 ). It provides a shared procedure for offline and online verification using the sources and inspection tools available in each setting. Verification begins after the executing agent’s attempt ends. The verifier first explores the available context to understand the app and its task artifacts, then uses these observations with the instruction to construct a rubric of fine-grained requirements. This context helps interpret task concepts and locate potential evidence, especially when the application is unfamiliar. The verifier chooses GUI or code tools to check the rubric’s requirements. Findings from these checks reveal what remains unresolved and guide further inspection of relevant frames, artifacts, or another available source.
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这些证据与访问上的限制，我们提出 VeriCUA，一个平台无关的框架，将 CUA 验证表述为智能体式探索（图 1）。 它提供了一套共享的流程，利用各场景中可用的信息来源与检查工具，进行离线与在线验证。 验证在执行智能体的尝试结束后开始。 验证者首先探索可用的上下文，以理解应用及其任务产物，然后结合这些观察结果与指令，构建一份由细粒度要求组成的评分标准。 这些上下文有助于解释任务概念并定位潜在证据，尤其是在应用不熟悉的情况下。 验证者选择 GUI 或代码工具来核查评分标准中的各项要求。 这些检查的结果会揭示哪些内容尚未解决，并引导对相关帧、产物或其他可用来源的进一步检查。

paragraphs.en: VeriCUA’s unified design separates the verification workflow from the interfaces through which evidence is obtained. Offline verification navigates retained screen frames and action logs, using structured observations such as accessibility trees when recorded. Online verification can inspect the accessible machine state left by the executing agent through GUI or code tools, including files, databases, and system services. These sources answer different questions about the requested outcome. An action log records an attempted edit, while a file read can show whether the edited content persisted. A report that the task is complete remains a claim to verify. The framework links findings to their supporting observations and records source properties such as frame timing or state persistence. Explicit evidence rules combine the findings into a task verdict while retaining which requirements are supported, refuted, or unresolved.
paragraphs.zh: VeriCUA 的统一设计将验证工作流与获取证据的接口分离开来。 离线验证通过浏览保留的屏幕帧和操作日志来进行，并在已录制的情况下使用诸如无障碍树等结构化观察信息。 在线验证可以通过 GUI 工具或代码工具检查执行智能体留下的可访问机器状态，包括文件、数据库和系统服务。 这些来源回答的是关于所请求结果的不同问题。 操作日志记录的是一次尝试过的编辑，而读取文件则可以显示编辑后的内容是否已持久保存。 一份声称任务已完成的报告仍然只是有待验证的主张。 该框架将验证发现与其支持的观察结果相关联，并记录诸如帧时间或状态持久性等来源属性。 显式证据规则将这些发现综合为任务判定，同时保留哪些需求已被支持、被反驳或尚未解决的信息。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate this shared procedure in offline and online scenarios on multiple platforms. VeriCUA achieves higher agreement with reference labels than the compared baselines in both settings. It also rejects more false completion claims than the VLM judge in the online study. The action-space study shows that adding code-based state reads enables more decisions without increasing false positives. At a matched number of verification passes, adding visual evidence improves agreement and decision coverage compared with repeating the same configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在多个平台的离线和在线场景中评估这一共享流程。 在两种设置中，VeriCUA 与参考标签的一致性均高于所比较的基线方法。 在在线研究中，它拒绝错误完成声明的数量也多于 VLM 裁判。 动作空间研究表明，加入基于代码的状态读取能够在不增加误报的情况下支持更多决策。 在验证次数匹配的条件下，与重复相同配置相比，加入视觉证据能提升一致性和决策覆盖率。

paragraphs.en: Computer-using agents are evaluated on web, mobile, and desktop tasks ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Rawles et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) , with dedicated environments covering scientific applications ( Sun et al., 2026c ) . These benchmarks typically use task-specific programmatic evaluators to check the resulting application state. Human-labeled trajectory datasets provide reference judgments across applications ( Sun et al., 2026a ) , while audits of benchmark evaluators identify errors in the checks used to produce reference labels ( Xie et al., 2025 ) . Benchmarks of environment-aware judges assess evidence acquisition and verification of states and execution processes ( Shi et al., 2026 ) . Completion judgments also support data curation and training beyond benchmark evaluation. Trajectory synthesis pipelines use verifier scores to select examples ( Sun et al., 2025 ) , and continual reinforcement learning relies on automated feedback during environment adaptation ( Xue et al., 2026a ) . Rubric-based reward modeling further uses synthetic criteria derived from preferred and rejected responses ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Safety-oriented evaluation additionally examines whether agent behavior satisfies workflow constraints ( Sun et al., 2026b ) . The range of applications and evaluation criteria creates demand for verification that can locate relevant evidence through available interfaces, including tasks without a dedicated evaluator.
paragraphs.zh: 使用计算机的智能体在网页、移动端和桌面任务上接受评估（Zhou et al., 2024；Rawles et al., 2025；Xie et al., 2024），并有覆盖科学应用的专用环境（Sun et al., 2026c）。 这些基准通常使用针对任务的程序化评估器来检查最终的应用状态。 人工标注的轨迹数据集为各应用提供了参考判断（Sun et al., 2026a），而对基准评估器的审计则识别出用于生成参考标签的检查中的错误（Xie et al., 2025）。 环境感知裁判的基准评估证据获取以及对状态和执行过程的验证（Shi et al., 2026）。 完成度判断还在基准评估之外支持数据整理与训练。 轨迹合成流水线使用验证器分数来筛选样本（Sun et al., 2025），而持续强化学习依赖于环境适应过程中的自动化反馈（Xue et al., 2026a）。 基于评分标准的奖励建模进一步使用从偏好响应和被拒响应中推导出的合成标准（Liu et al., 2026）。 面向安全的评估还考察智能体行为是否满足工作流约束（Sun et al., 2026b）。 应用范围和评估标准的多样性产生了对验证的需求，即能够通过可用接口定位相关证据的验证，包括没有专用评估器的任务。

paragraphs.en: VLM judges assess task completion from trajectory observations ( Pan et al., 2024 ) , while structured critics evaluate task requirements or intermediate milestones ( Li et al., 2026 ) . Task-adaptive rubrics can be generated from task descriptions to guide trajectory evaluation ( Ding, 2026 ) . Generated verifiers construct programs that inspect application state ( Xue et al., 2026b ) . Reward benchmarks evaluate the reliability of trajectory judgments against reference labels across tasks and platforms ( Sun et al., 2026a ; Lin et al., 2025 ) . Agent-based evaluators assess intermediate task requirements in code-generation workflows ( Zhuge et al., 2025 ) . Agentic approaches gather additional evidence by iteratively inspecting recorded trajectories ( Wan et al., 2026 ) or interacting with the execution environment ( Cui et al., 2026 ) . Evidence-first verification separates investigation from validation, checking proposed claims against their state or trace sources before accepting rubric verdicts ( Sanayei et al., 2026 ) . These approaches motivate both seeking task-relevant evidence and assessing how it supports a judgment. VeriCUA builds its rubric after inspecting the available environment or recording, then selects GUI or code checks for unresolved requirements. Source-aware rules combine the resulting findings within a shared offline and online verification workflow.
paragraphs.zh: VLM 评判者根据轨迹观察评估任务完成情况（Pan et al., 2024），而结构化评论者则评估任务需求或中间里程碑（Li et al., 2026）。 可以从任务描述生成任务自适应评分细则，以指导轨迹评估（Ding, 2026）。 生成的验证器构建用于检查应用状态的程序（Xue et al., 2026b）。 奖励基准针对参考标签，跨任务和平台评估轨迹判断的可靠性（Sun et al., 2026a；Lin et al., 2025）。 基于智能体的评估器在代码生成工作流中评估中间任务需求（Zhuge et al., 2025）。 智能体式方法通过迭代检查记录的轨迹（Wan et al., 2026）或与执行环境交互（Cui et al., 2026）来收集额外证据。 证据优先的验证将调查与验证分离，在接受评分细则结论之前，先对照状态或追踪来源检查所提出的论断（Sanayei et al., 2026）。 这些方法既促使人们寻求与任务相关的证据，也促使人们评估证据如何支持某个判断。 VeriCUA 在检查可用环境或录制内容之后构建评分细则，然后为未解决的需求选择 GUI 检查或代码检查。 来源感知的规则在共享的离线与在线验证工作流中整合由此得到的发现。

paragraphs.en: An instruction specifies the requested result but may leave its application-specific interpretation implicit. A request to save a note, for example, does not necessarily identify the application’s storage directory or explain which view reveals whether the note persisted. Generating requirements without this context can introduce assumptions about files or interface elements that the application does not expose.

paragraphs.en: GUI tools support visual inspection through frame selection, region enlargement, and optical character recognition (OCR), while code tools query exposed machine state. paragraphs.en: The verifier chooses its next inspection from the findings already collected, focusing on requirements that remain unresolved within the available access. A text match may leave persistence unresolved and prompt a file read; an unclear frame may prompt a crop or inspection of a later frame. The harness records the executed tool, arguments, and source metadata, including frame timing or the persistence of queried state. The executed read determines these attributes, which are attached to the resulting findings. The complete tool inventory is given in Appendix A.2 .

paragraphs.en: VeriCUA links each finding to an executed read, then applies source constraints and corroboration rules before assigning requirement statuses.
paragraphs.zh: VeriCUA 将每个发现与一次已执行的读取相关联，然后在分配需求状态之前应用来源约束和佐证规则。

paragraphs.en: Each finding identifies a rubric requirement, states the support or refutation inferred from an observation, and cites the executed check that returned the observation. The harness rejects citations that match no executed call and attaches each valid citation’s observation and source attributes to the finding. Source attributes and corroborating probes then determine how each linked assessment contributes to a requirement’s status.
paragraphs.zh: 每条发现都会指出一项评分标准要求，陈述由某次观察推断出的支持或反驳，并引用返回该观察的已执行检查。 该测试框架会拒绝未匹配任何已执行调用的引用，并将每个有效引用的观察结果和来源属性附加到对应发现上。 来源属性和佐证探针随后决定每条关联评估如何对一项要求的状态做出贡献。

paragraphs.en: The attested / asserted source labels distinguish observations of task state from records of the executing agent’s intent or claims. A post-action frame, a file read, or a database query can provide attested evidence. The executing agent’s completion message and a pre-action frame showing an intended operation are asserted evidence for that operation’s outcome. Asserted evidence can direct further inspection but cannot alone mark a requirement met .
paragraphs.zh: 已验证 / 声明的来源标签用于区分对任务状态的观察与执行智能体的意图或声明的记录。 操作后的帧、文件读取或数据库查询可以提供已验证的证据。 执行智能体的完成消息以及显示预期操作的操作前帧，是该操作结果的声明性证据。 声明性证据可以引导进一步的检查，但不能仅凭其自身将需求标记为已满足。

paragraphs.en: Source attributes further constrain what an observation can support, including whether a recorded image precedes or follows the action whose effect is being checked. Online reads distinguish persistent artifacts from volatile interface state, which can answer different questions about the same requirement. For example, a screen displaying edited text can support its visible contents, while a file read can check whether that text was saved. A finding must address the task requirement, and its observation must satisfy the source conditions for the inference being made.
paragraphs.zh: 来源属性进一步约束观察所能支持的内容，包括记录的图像是在其效果正被检查的动作之前还是之后拍摄的。 在线读取区分持久产物与易失性界面状态，二者可以就同一需求回答不同的问题。 例如，显示已编辑文本的屏幕可以支持其可见内容，而文件读取可以检查该文本是否已保存。 结论必须针对任务需求，且其观察必须满足所做推理的来源条件。

paragraphs.en: The arbiter applies the setting’s confirmation and refutation rules to the stored findings ℰ L \mathcal{E}_{L} , assigning each requirement a status of met , unmet , or unknown . A met status requires attested support, while unmet requires corroborating refutations from separate probes. Evidence that does not settle the requirement leaves it unknown . The task verdict is success when all hard requirements are met , and fail when any is unmet . If some remain unknown and none is unmet , the task is unresolved and follows the setting’s abstention or fallback policy. Aggregation is deterministic for fixed findings and rules; the stored records allow confirmation thresholds to be re-evaluated without repeating inspection actions.
paragraphs.zh: 仲裁者对存储的发现 ℰ_L \mathcal{E}_{L} 应用该设置的确认与反驳规则，为每项要求赋予已满足、未满足或未知的状态。 已满足状态需要经证实的支持，而未满足则需要来自独立探测的相互印证的反驳。 无法确定该要求真伪的证据会使其保持未知状态。 当所有硬性要求均为已满足时，任务判定为成功；当任一要求为未满足时，任务判定为失败。 如果部分要求仍为未知且没有要求为未满足，则任务为未解决状态，并遵循该设置的弃权或回退策略。 对于固定的发现和规则，聚合是确定性的；存储的记录使得确认阈值可以在不重复检查动作的情况下被重新评估。

paragraphs.en: Online machine access allows the verifier to combine GUI inspection with code-based checks of stored artifacts. Task-specific checkers can be reused across repeated executions of the same task with compatible application schemas. Persistent attested reads can confirm requirements, while volatile observations provide corroboration. The verifier abstains on unresolved tasks to avoid assigning training or filtering labels unsupported by the collected evidence.

paragraphs.en: VeriCUA audits fixed, time-stamped recordings through multiple paths, seeking support through forward inspection and refutations through backward inspection. A requirement is met when every completed path provides attested support. For tasks left unresolved, the reported configuration uses an initial judgment : a single-pass VLM assessment of the retained trajectory computed before exploration and withheld from the audit paths. This fallback supplies the final verdict while unresolved requirements remain unknown . Detailed setting rules and inspection budgets are given in Appendices A.1 and B.3 .
paragraphs.zh: VeriCUA 通过多条路径审计固定的、带时间戳的录像，通过前向检查寻求支持，并通过后向检查寻求反驳。 当每条已完成的路径都提供经过证实的支持时，该需求即被满足。 对于未解决的任务，所报告的配置使用初始判断：即在探索之前计算并从审计路径中隐藏的、对保留轨迹的单次 VLM 评估。 在未解决的需求仍未知的情况下，该回退机制提供最终判定。 详细的设置规则与检查预算见附录 A.1 和 B.3。

paragraphs.en: In online environments, we run AndroidWorld ( Rawles et al., 2025 ) on an Android emulator, OSWorld ( Xie et al., 2024 ) in a virtual machine, and ScienceBoard ( Sun et al., 2026c ) in its scientific desktop environment. Each episode is executed by the benchmark’s own agent scaffold, and the verifier probes the resulting machine state after the episode ends. For offline verification, we evaluate recorded WebArena trajectories from three executing agents ( Zhou et al., 2024 ) and the human-labeled OSReward trajectories ( Sun et al., 2026a ) , which span four platforms and several agents.
paragraphs.zh: 在在线环境中，我们在 Android 模拟器上运行 AndroidWorld（Rawles et al., 2025），在虚拟机中运行 OSWorld（Xie et al., 2024），并在其科学桌面环境中运行 ScienceBoard（Sun et al., 2026c）。 每个回合由基准测试自带的智能体脚手架执行，验证器在回合结束后探测所产生的机器状态。 在离线验证中，我们评估来自三个执行智能体（Zhou et al., 2024）的 WebArena 录制轨迹以及人工标注的 OSReward 轨迹（Sun et al., 2026a），它们涵盖四个平台和多个智能体。

paragraphs.en: Across the three online environments, VeriCUA has the highest accuracy and lowest false-positive rate (Table 1 ). The auto-generated verifier has higher accuracy than the VLM judge in each environment. The largest gap is on ScienceBoard, where generated checks are not reliably aligned with the target scientific software. Scripts constructed without context inspection can query incorrect state locations. VeriCUA inspects the application context before generating checks, and its false-positive rate is roughly a quarter of the generated verifier’s. The generated verifier has higher recall on OSWorld and ScienceBoard, while VeriCUA has higher precision and accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: 在三个在线环境中，VeriCUA 具有最高的准确率和最低的误报率（表 1）。 在每个环境中，自动生成的验证器都比 VLM 判别器具有更高的准确率。 差距最大的是 ScienceBoard，在该环境中生成的检查无法可靠地与目标科学软件对齐。 在未进行上下文检查的情况下构建的脚本可能会查询错误的状态位置。 VeriCUA 在生成检查之前会先检查应用上下文，其误报率约为生成验证器的四分之一。 生成的验证器在 OSWorld 和 ScienceBoard 上具有更高的召回率，而 VeriCUA 则具有更高的精确率和准确率。

paragraphs.en: On online AndroidWorld, adding code-based state checks to GUI inspection increases the decision rate and recall while leaving false positives unchanged (Figure 3 ). In the paired analysis, every additional correct decision from the code channel is supported by a file or application-store read. Access to stored state therefore resolves requirements that GUI observations leave unsettled.
paragraphs.zh: 在线上 AndroidWorld 中，在 GUI 检查的基础上加入基于代码的状态检查，可提升决策率和召回率，同时保持误报不变（图 3）。 在配对分析中，代码通道带来的每一项额外正确决策都有文件读取或应用商店读取作为支撑。 因此，对已存储状态的访问能够解决 GUI 观察无法确定的需求。

paragraphs.en: We presented VeriCUA, a platform-agnostic framework for verifying computer-using agents through agentic exploration. The verifier inspects available context before constructing a task rubric, then selects GUI or code checks to gather evidence for unresolved requirements. Source-aware arbitration combines the findings within a shared workflow for offline recordings and online environments. Across the evaluated platforms, VeriCUA improves agreement with reference labels over the compared baselines, with fewer false positives online and the largest offline gains on hard trajectories. Analyses show that complementary evidence sources and verification passes improve decision coverage, while stronger backbones further improve accuracy. These results support agentic verification for CUA evaluation and motivate its use in data curation and reinforcement learning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 VeriCUA，一个通过智能体探索来验证计算机使用智能体的平台无关框架。 验证器在构建任务评分标准之前会先检查可用的上下文，然后选择图形界面检查或代码检查来为尚未解决的需求收集证据。 源感知仲裁在共享工作流中整合针对离线录制与在线环境的发现结果。 在所评估的各个平台上，VeriCUA 相比所对比的基线提升了与参考标签的一致性，在线场景中减少了误报，并且在困难轨迹上取得了最大的离线增益。 分析表明，互补的证据来源与多轮验证提升了决策覆盖面，而更强的骨干模型进一步提高了准确性。 这些结果支持将智能体验证用于 CUA 评估，并推动其在数据整理与强化学习中的应用。

paragraphs.en: On recorded trajectories, up to K K audit paths gather support through forward inspection and seek refutations through backward inspection. The default K = 3 K=3 permits early stopping after two paths agree on every hard requirement. If the evidence does not settle the task, the initial judgment supplies the fallback verdict without adding attested support to unknown requirements.

sents.en: If the evidence does not settle the task, the initial judgment supplies the fallback verdict without adding attested support to unknown requirements.
sents.zh: 如果证据无法解决该任务，则初始判断提供后备裁定，且不会向未知的要求添加经证实的支持。

paragraphs.en: In online environments, initial inspection maps the device’s packages, stores, and schemas before rubric synthesis. The observed context informs the rubric and subsequent checker construction; each requirement receives checkers on more than one surface where possible; predicates are evaluated by a restricted evaluator or, for semantic comparisons, by a judge call; a requirement is met by one persistent attested confirmation and unmet by two corroborating refutations (the unmet_min threshold, which trades decided episodes for precision when raised). An unresolved task produces an abstention, which binary evaluation counts as fail . Across passes, the combination rule takes the decided verdict and abstains when two decided verdicts disagree.
paragraphs.zh: 在在线环境中，初始检查会在量规合成之前映射设备的软件包、存储与模式。 观察到的上下文为量规及后续检查器的构建提供依据；每个需求在可能的情况下会在多个表面上获得检查器；谓词由受限评估器求值，或在语义比较时由一次 judge 调用求值；一个需求由一条持久的已证实确认判定为满足，由两条相互印证的反驳判定为不满足（即 unmet_min 阈值，提高该阈值会以牺牲已判定回合数来换取精确度）。 未解决的任务会产生弃权，二元评估将其计为失败。 在多轮通过中，组合规则采纳已判定的结论，并在两个已判定结论不一致时弃权。

paragraphs.en: On recordings the read-only property is structural, since every verb is a pure function of files on disk. On a machine the verbs come from a fixed allowlist, arguments that could smuggle shell control are rejected, and a digest of the plan’s persistent targets is compared before and after execution.
paragraphs.zh: 在录制中，只读属性是结构性的，因为每个动词都是磁盘文件的纯函数。 在机器上，动词来自固定的允许列表，可能夹带 shell 控制字符的参数会被拒绝，并且会在执行前后比较计划持久目标摘要的哈希值。

paragraphs.en: In online environments, VeriCUA runs against AndroidWorld on an Android emulator. The harness has root access over adb , so every store the benchmark’s own evaluator can read is readable by the verifier. Each episode is executed by the benchmark’s agent scaffold; when it ends, the harness saves the device state as a snapshot and verification runs against that snapshot, so any verification pass can be replayed on the identical end state. Before the episode starts, the harness records a pre-state anchor of the application storage, against which requirements about a change are compared. The agent’s submitted answer is extracted by the harness and exposed through the submitted_answer getter as the artifact under test.
paragraphs.zh: 在在线环境中，VeriCUA 在 Android 模拟器上针对 AndroidWorld 运行。 该测试框架通过 adb 拥有 root 权限，因此基准评测自身的评估器所能读取的每个存储，验证器都可以读取。 每个回合（episode）由基准评测的智能体框架执行；当回合结束时，测试框架将设备状态保存为快照，并针对该快照运行验证，因此任何一次验证过程都可以在完全相同的最终状态上重放。 在回合开始之前，测试框架会记录应用存储的初始状态锚点，关于变更的要求将与之进行比对。 智能体提交的答案由测试框架提取，并通过 submitted_answer 取值器暴露，作为被测对象（artifact under test）。

paragraphs.en: The condenser writes one line per node of the browser’s accessibility dump, indented by depth, with the node id, role, name, and ten retained properties such as value, checked, focused, and url. Ignored nodes and nameless nodes without properties are dropped, and names are cut to 110 characters. A read returns at most 150 lines with a note on how many nodes were left out, a query returns at most 40 matching lines, and a search across steps returns the first match in each of up to 12 steps. Each trajectory enters as one record that lists, per step, the agent’s thought and action, the page URL, and the paths of the screenshot and the tree.
paragraphs.zh: 压缩器（condenser）为浏览器无障碍转储的每个节点写一行内容，按深度缩进，包含节点 id、角色（role）、名称（name）以及十个保留属性，例如 value、checked、focused 和 url。 被忽略的节点以及没有属性的无名节点会被丢弃，名称会被截断至 110 个字符。 一次读取最多返回 150 行，并附注有多少节点被省略；一次查询最多返回 40 个匹配行；跨步骤搜索则在每个步骤（最多 12 个步骤）中返回首个匹配项。 每条轨迹作为一条记录进入，其中逐步骤列出智能体的思考和动作、页面 URL 以及截图和树的路径。

paragraphs.en: The multi-pass suite keeps every snapshot on which the agent claimed completion but gold says fail , on which the configurations disagree, or on which any pass abstained.
paragraphs.zh: 多轮测试套件会保留每一个满足以下条件的快照：智能体声称已完成但标准答案判定为失败、各配置意见不一致，或任一轮次选择弃权的快照。

paragraphs.en: TRM scores the trajectory from 1 to 5 in a single call from the instruction, every thought and action, and the last three frames; CUAJudge checks up to six task-derived key points against the first and last of up to six frames in a single call; OS-Themis verifies up to four ordered milestones over up to eight frames and reviews them in a second call.
paragraphs.zh: TRM 在单次调用中根据指令、每一步思考和动作以及最后三帧对轨迹进行 1 到 5 的评分；CUAJudge 在单次调用中针对最多六帧中的第一帧和最后一帧检查最多六个源自任务的关键点；OS-Themis 在最多八帧上验证最多四个有序里程碑，并在第二次调用中对其进行复核。

paragraphs.en: The three offline judges run under one harness at temperature 0, with images downsampled to a long side of 1280 pixels, the first and last frames pinned, no self-consistency voting, and a parse failure mapped to fail . TRM thresholds its 1–5 score at 4 and is the only judge that sees the agent’s thoughts. CUAJudge collapses the original four-stage pipeline into one call, dropping the dedicated frame-selection and init-versus-final modules. OS-Themis collapses the multi-agent critic to two calls with the budget cut to four milestones and eight frames against the original six and twelve; Table C.6 shows that restoring the original budget changes little.
paragraphs.zh: 三个离线裁判在同一个评测框架下以温度 0 运行，图像下采样至长边 1280 像素，首帧与末帧固定，不使用自一致性投票，解析失败记为 fail。 TRM 将其 1–5 分数以 4 为阈值，并且是唯一能看到智能体思考过程的裁判。 CUAJudge 将原本的四阶段流水线压缩为一次调用，去掉了专门的帧选择模块与初始-最终对比模块。 OS-Themis 将多智能体评审压缩为两次调用，预算从原来的六个里程碑和十二帧削减为四个里程碑和八帧；表 C.6 显示恢复原始预算后变化很小。

paragraphs.en: The online VLM judge answers in one word from the instruction and the final screenshot and never abstains; the auto-generated verifier writes one evaluator script per task with full device access and runs it once.
paragraphs.zh: 在线 VLM 裁判根据指令和最终截图用一个词作答，从不弃权；自动生成的验证器为每个任务编写一个评估脚本，拥有完整的设备访问权限，并运行该脚本一次。

paragraphs.en: The auto-generated verifier receives the instruction with its concrete parameters, the same generic device context our synthesis receives, unrestricted host-side adb and Python, and the agent’s submitted answer on answer-scored tasks. It does not receive the trajectory, the results of context inspection, or the pre-state anchor, and it runs last on each end state.
paragraphs.zh: 自动生成的校验器会接收带有具体参数的指令、与我们的合成所收到的相同的通用设备上下文、不受限制的主机端 adb 和 Python，以及在按答案评分的任务上智能体提交的答案。 它不会接收轨迹、上下文检查的结果或前状态锚点，并且它在每个结束状态上最后运行。

paragraphs.en: Majority voting combines the same three verifier draws by vote with abstentions folded to fail .
paragraphs.zh: 多数投票通过投票方式组合相同的三个验证器抽样，并将弃权计入失败。

paragraphs.en: The default runs K = 3 K=3 paths and stops after two when they agree on the status of every hard requirement, which happens on about two fifths of the trajectories. A path spends up to four tool calls gathering support and then at least four, or two per hard requirement, hunting refutations. Each call returns one observation, frames are downscaled to at most 1288 pixels on the long side, and only the last eight images stay in context.
paragraphs.zh: 默认运行 K = 3 条路径，当两条路径对所有硬性要求的状态达成一致时即在两条后停止，这种情况大约发生在五分之二的轨迹上。 每条路径最多花费四次工具调用来收集支持证据，然后至少花费四次调用（即每个硬性要求两次）来寻找反驳。 每次调用返回一个观察结果，图像帧在长边上最多降采样至 1288 像素，且只有最后八张图像保留在上下文中。

paragraphs.en: Rubric synthesis draws two candidate rubrics at temperature 0.7 and consolidates them in a third call at temperature 0; checker synthesis makes two parallel calls at temperature 0.7 and asks for two checkers per hard requirement on different surfaces where the state allows it; context inspection uses one call over at most three packages and six databases, followed by one schema probe; a semantic predicate costs one judge call at temperature 0 over at most three images.
paragraphs.zh: 评分标准合成（rubric synthesis）在温度 0.7 下生成两份候选评分标准，并在第三次调用中以温度 0 将它们合并；检查器合成（checker synthesis）在温度 0.7 下进行两次并行调用，并在状态允许的情况下，针对不同表面（surface）为每条硬性要求生成两个检查器；上下文检查（context inspection）对至多三个包和六个数据库使用一次调用，随后进行一次模式探测（schema probe）；语义谓词（semantic predicate）需要一次温度为 0 的评判调用，最多覆盖三张图像。

paragraphs.en: The gold-label audit uses 814 recorded trajectories from AndroidWorld, OSWorld, and WebArena. It sees only the instruction, the agent’s thought and action log, and up to ten evenly spaced frames including the last one, never the verifier’s verdict, the gold label, or the verifier’s reasoning, and it may answer success , fail , or unsure .

paragraphs.en: VeriCUA trades cost for evidence. A verification pass issues tens of tool calls and model calls per trajectory, an order of magnitude more than a single-call judge, so it suits filtering and reward assignment better than interactive use. On recorded trajectories it abstains wherever the recording holds no evidence for a requirement. Those abstentions are a coverage limit, and online access lifts it only for environments that can be instrumented. A stochastic verifier also needs its draw-to-draw spread reported beside every comparison, as we do. Reliable trajectory verification lowers the cost of training computer-using agents and of auditing benchmark labels. The same machinery could be misused to certify agents that act on real systems, which is one reason VeriCUA never writes to the environment it verifies.
paragraphs.zh: VeriCUA 以成本换取证据。 一次验证流程会对每条轨迹发出数十次工具调用和模型调用，比单次调用的评判器高出一个数量级，因此它更适合用于过滤和奖励分配，而非交互式使用。 对于录制的轨迹，只要录制内容中不包含某项要求的证据，它就会弃权。 这些弃权是一种覆盖范围限制，只有对可以插桩的环境，在线访问才能突破这一限制。 随机验证器还需要像我们这样，在每次比较旁边报告其抽样间波动。 可靠的轨迹验证降低了训练计算机操作智能体的成本，也降低了审计基准标签的成本。 同样的机制也可能被滥用于认证在真实系统上执行操作的智能体，这也是 VeriCUA 从不向其验证的环境写入内容的原因之一。

paragraphs.en: You decompose a computer-use task into atomic, individually checkable requirements for a verifier. Output requirements about the FINAL END-STATE the task demands (what a programmatic checker inspecting files/documents/settings afterwards would verify), NOT about the method or the steps taken. Rules: - Each requirement is one concrete, verifiable condition. - Honor every quantifier/detail: "all"/"each" => ALL; exact names/values/paths => exact. Split compound asks into separate requirements. - Mark hard (must hold for success) or soft (minor/cosmetic). - Do NOT invent process requirements ("must have clicked X"); if the end-state is right, the route does not matter. Output ONLY: ```json {"requirements": [{"id": "r1", "description": "...", "hard": true}, ...]} ```
